injuries.name: Jalen Johnson
injuries.note: Johnson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) has progressed to full contact basketball activities, per NBA writer Justin Russo.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.note: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.note: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.note: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.note: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.note: Aldama (knee) is probable to suit up for Friday's game against the Jazz.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.note: Head coach Tiago Splittler said Friday that Claxton (hamstring) is expected to make his season debut Sunday against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.note: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.note: Tyson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.note: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Moussa Diabate
injuries.note: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season Thursday.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.note: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.note: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis,".

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.note: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.note: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.note: Jones (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.note: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.note: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.note: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months.

injuries.name: Grant Williams

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.note: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams

injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert

injuries.name: Devin Carter

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II

injuries.name: Nikola Topic

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.note: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday.

injuries.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
injuries.note: Shannon (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.note: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.note: Newell (toe) is out for Friday's game against Washington.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.note: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.note: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.note: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.note: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle

injuries.name: Reece Beekman

injuries.name: Immanuel Quickley

injuries.name: Anthony Davis

injuries.note: DeRozan has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors due to lower-back spasms.

Acquired G Max Strus from Cleveland.
Acquired draft considerations from Cleveland Guardians for G Peyton Watson.

Acquired G Ryan Nembhard from Dallas and G Luguentz Dort from Oklahoma City in a three-team trade that sent F Zaccharie Risacher to Dallas. Dallas received draft consideration from Atlanta, while Oklahoma City received draft considerations from Atlanta and Dallas.
Acquired G Grayson Allen, F Royce O'Neale and draft considerations from Phoenix Suns for F Miles Bridges and draft considerations.
Acquired F Miles Bridges and draft considerations from Charlotte in exchange for G Grayson Allen, F Royce O'Neale and draft considerations.

Acquired G Jaden Hardy from Washington in exchange for draft considerations.
Acquired draft considerations from Atlanta Hawks for G Aaron Wiggins.
Signed G Anfernee Simons and F Dean Wade to contracts. Acquired G Jaylen Brown from the Boston Celtics. Signed C Ariel Hukporti to a contract.

Re-signed F Andrew Wiggins to a veteran extension. Acquired Fs Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gs Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kasparas Jakucionis, C Kel'el Ware and draft considerations. Signed G Tim Hardaway Jr. to a contract.
